summary: Iteration 92 — Scenic route elevation backfill + Workout Music playlist deep-link. Backend: initial GET /api/scenic/routes still had 14 published routes with null distance_km / elevation_m and empty elevation_profile despite the new _METRICS_BACKFILL block; a manual invocation of scenic.backfill_route_metrics() then filled them and all 6 pytest checks pass — root cause is a startup-order bug (see rca_of_issue). Frontend: on the live structured workout (/workout?workoutId=w1), the Music & audio panel opens via the bottom 'Audio' pill (testID bc-audio, NOT music-button — see ui_bug), PlaylistSection renders with playlist-input + playlist-add, Spotify (open.spotify.com) and Apple Music (music.apple.com) links each add a playlist-row-* with a Play (playlist-play-*) and Remove (playlist-remove-*) button, the Apple row is auto-labelled 'Todays Hits' from the slug, an invalid 'hello' input shows the inline 'Paste a Spotify or Apple Music playlist link.' error and adds no row, and remove buttons correctly delete rows.

minor.issue: Startup-order bug: seed_scenic_routes() runs BEFORE seed_prod.seed_production_data(). Content_seed scenic routes (tyrol-three-lakes, adige-valley-to-garda, walchensee-loop, dolomites-cortina-calalzo, hells-gate-safari, brixen-vineyards-loop, adige-bozen-lavis, bavarian-roman-roads, isar-autumn, fedaia-dam-descent, passo-fedaia-climb, ledro-to-garda-ponale, garda-sunrise-promenade, brixen-to-kiens-pustertal) are inserted AFTER backfill_route_metrics() has already run — so on subsequent boots the routes exist but the ones in _METRICS_BACKFILL still had distance_km=null / elevation_m=null. backfill_route_metrics() itself is correct (a manual REPL call fixed everything). Recommend: (a) also invoke scenic.backfill_route_metrics() AFTER seed_prod.seed_production_data() completes, and (b) remove the blanket `except Exception: pass` in backfill_route_metrics so failures surface. After my manual backfill run the API now returns non-null distance/elevation and elevation_profile length matching distance_km for all 27 published routes.

ui_bugs.issue: Review request expects the panel to open via testID 'music-button', but the actual button in the live workout screen is testID 'bc-audio' (workout-live.tsx:406). The MusicButton component with testID='music-button' (workout.tsx:995) is exported but not mounted here. Panel behaviour itself is fine — only the testID mismatches the spec. Consider unifying to one canonical id.

action_items: Fix startup ordering: call scenic.backfill_route_metrics() from server.py AFTER seed_prod.seed_production_data() completes (or move the backfill into seed_prod as a final step) so content_seed-loaded scenic routes are always corrected.
Remove/log the silent `except Exception: pass` in backfill_route_metrics so future backfill failures do not hide in preview.
Optional: add testID='music-button' to the actual pill in workout-live.tsx (or rename bc-audio) so QA scripts and the exported MusicButton use one canonical id.

Optional: for pasted Spotify links without a title, fetch and cache the playlist name via Spotify oEmbed (https://open.spotify.com/oembed?url=...) so the row title is not the generic 'Spotify playlist'.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/scenic.py backfill_route_metrics silently swallows all exceptions (line 850-851 `except Exception: pass`) — masks real bugs.
server.py orchestration relies on ordering: scenic seed runs before content_seed, so any data fixup done inside scenic.py cannot touch documents that only appear via seed_prod.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 after manual backfill; 1/6 without it on affected boots)

rca_of_issue: RCA — scenic elevation backfill did not persist on startup. Repro: fresh backend restart; GET /api/scenic/routes shows 14 of 27 routes with distance_km=null, elevation_m=null, elevation_profile=[]. The affected routes are all seeded from content_seed.json.gz by seed_prod.seed_production_data(). server.py:480 calls scenic_routes.seed_scenic_routes() first — its guard `if count>0: await backfill_route_metrics()` DID execute (routes existed from prior boot), but the routes were still null afterwards, likely because backfill's blanket `except Exception: pass` swallowed a Motor error. Two contributing factors: (1) startup order — on a truly fresh DB, backfill runs BEFORE content_seed inserts these routes; (2) the exception swallow hides any DB error on the 2nd+ boot. Mitigation applied for this iteration: manually called `await backfill_route_metrics()` from a python REPL — confirmed all 27 routes now expose distance_km, elevation_m and a valid per-km elevation_profile array (length matches distance_km rounded to nearest km, e.g. tyrol-three-lakes -> 24 samples, walchensee-loop -> 28 samples, isarco-river-path -> 13 samples). Long-term fix belongs to main agent (see action_items).
